- Gene ID mapping: counts have ENSG with version. Need to map to ENTREZID for enrichGO. Use gencode csv to get gene_name (symbols) or HGNC file. clusterProfiler enrichGO can take ENSEMBL ids with keyType="ENSEMBL". Version numbers need stripping.

- DESeq2 contrast: ASXL1 vs Control (default is last level alphabetically as reference: Control vs ASXL1). Doesn't matter for padj.

arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# DESeq2 DE analysis + clusterProfiler enrichGO (with simplify) for ASXL1 vs Control blood RNA-seq
suppressMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(readxl)
})

setwd("/workspace")

## ---------- 1. Load counts ----------
counts <- read.delim("Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt",
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(counts) <- counts$Geneid
counts <- counts[, -1]
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"
cat("Counts matrix:", nrow(counts), "genes x", ncol(counts), "samples\n")
print(colnames(counts))

## ---------- 2. Load metadata ----------
coldata <- as.data.frame(read_excel("Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx"))
coldata <- coldata[!is.na(coldata$sample) & coldata$sample != "", ]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition)
cat("\nColdata rows:", nrow(coldata), "\n")
print(table(coldata$condition))

# align
idx <- match(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
coldata <- coldata[idx, ]
stopifnot(all(rownames(coldata) == colnames(counts)))

## ---------- 3. DESeq2 ----------
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
cat("\nDESeq2 resultsNames:", resultsNames(dds), "\n")

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "ASXL1", "Control"))
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
cat("\nTotal genes tested:", sum(!is.na(res$padj)), "\n")

sig <- subset(res_df, padj < 0.05)
cat("Significant DEGs (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig), "\n")
up <- sum(sig$log2FoldChange > 0); dn <- sum(sig$log2FoldChange < 0)
cat("  up:", up, " down:", dn, "\n")

write.csv(data.frame(gene_id = rownames(sig), sig),
          "/workspace/deseq2_sig_DEGs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(gene_id = rownames(res_df), res_df),
          "/workspace/deseq2_all_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## ---------- 4. Map Ensembl -> Entrez ----------
ens <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(sig))
map <- bitr(ens, fromType = "ENSEMBL", toType = "ENTREZID",
            OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
cat("\nMapped", nrow(map), "of", length(unique(ens)), "Ensembl IDs to Entrez\n")
eg <- map$ENTREZID[!duplicated(map$ENTREZID)]

## ---------- 5. enrichGO + simplify ----------
ego <- enrichGO(gene = eg,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                ont = "BP",
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                readable = TRUE)
cat("\nenrichGO terms before simplify:", nrow(as.data.frame(ego)), "\n")

ego_s <- clusterProfiler::simplify(ego, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust",
                                   select_fun = min, measure = "Resnik")
ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego_s)
cat("enrichGO terms after simplify (similarity > 0.7 removed):", nrow(ego_df), "\n")

write.csv(ego_df, "/workspace/enrichGO_simplified.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(ego), "/workspace/enrichGO_full.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## ---------- 6. Look for T cell activation term ----------
hit <- ego_df[grepl("regulation of T cell activation", ego_df$Description), ]
cat("\n==== 'regulation of T cell activation' in SIMPLIFIED results ====\n")
print(hit[, c("ID", "Description", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count", "GeneRatio")])

cat("\n==== Any T cell terms in simplified results ====\n")
print(ego_df[grepl("T cell", ego_df$Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
            c("ID", "Description", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count")])

cat("\n==== Top 25 simplified GO terms ====\n")
print(head(ego_df[, c("ID", "Description", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count")], 25))

cat("\nSession info (key packages):\n")
print(sessionInfo()$otherPkgs$DESeq2$Version)
print(sessionInfo()$otherPkgs$clusterProfiler$Version)

new("MethodDefinition", .Data = function (x, ...) 
{
    .local <- function (x, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min, 
        measure = "Wang", semData = NULL) 
    {
        if (!x@ontology %in% c("BP", "MF", "CC", "GOALL")) 
            stop("simplify only applied to output from gsegO and enrichGO...")
        res <- as.data.frame(x)
        if (x@ontology == "GOALL") {
            x@result <- simplify_ALL(res = res, cutoff = cutoff, 
                by = by, select_fun = select_fun, measure = measure, 
                semData = semData)
        }
        else {
            x@result <- simplify_internal(res = res, cutoff = cutoff, 
                by = by, select_fun = select_fun, measure = measure, 
                ontology = x@ontology, semData = semData)
        }
        return(x)
    }
    .local(x, ...)
}, target = new("signature", .Data = "enrichResult", names = "x", 
    package = "DOSE"), defined = new("signature", .Data = "enrichResult", 
    names = "x", package = "DOSE"), generic = "simplify")
